faqs.a:
(a)
Applicability.
Except as otherwise noted herein, this article governs the impoundment and disposition
               by the city of animals including those seized under
section 14-9
of this Code.
(b)
Definitions.
As used in this article, unless the context otherwise requires:
Care
or
care and provision
means those actions and activities reasonably necessary to provide adequate food,
               shelter, and socialization to an animal during its impoundment and includes veterinary
               care reasonably necessary to assess and stabilize an animal and to otherwise provide
               reasonable veterinary care, if any, to the animal throughout the term of its impoundment.
(
Ord. No. 4878
, § 9, 10-7-2024)
